name: Lena, Selfless Champion — the fired ability reaches only your creatures with less power than Lena
notes: Memory: project_source_compared_subjects_judged_after_layer_7_2026-10-16. 'Sacrifice Lena: Creatures you control with power less than Lena's power gain indestructible until end of turn': the fire-time power bound was only written in after 'target', so 'with power less than this card's power' stayed a required subtype and nothing gained indestructible. It is now written as 'with power 2 or less' from the fire-time snapshot (Lena 3/3): Elvish Mystic (1) and Grizzly Bears (2) gain it, Hill Giant (3), Lena and the opponent's Llanowar Elves do not.

scryfallData.name: Llanowar Elves
scryfallData.flavor_text: The elves of the Llanowar forest have defended it for generations. It is their sacred duty to keep outside influences from corrupting their ancestral home.

scryfallData.name: Elvish Mystic
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"The Three Rings of the Elves were not made as weapons of war or conquest—that is not their power. Those who made them did not desire strength or domination or hoarded wealth, but understanding, making, and healing, to preserve all things unstained."
—Elrond

scryfallData.name: Grizzly Bears
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"We cannot forget that among all of Dominaria's wonders, a system of life exists, with prey and predators that will never fight wars nor vie for ancient power."
—Jolrael, empress of beasts

scryfallData.name: Hill Giant
scryfallData.flavor_text: Fortunately, hill giants have large blind spots in which a human can easily hide. Unfortunately, these blind spots are beneath the bottoms of their feet.

scryfallData.name: Lena, Selfless Champion
scryfallData.oracle_text:
When Lena enters, create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token for each nontoken creature you control.
Sacrifice Lena: Creatures you control with power less than Lena's power gain indestructible until end of turn.
scryfallData.flavor_text: "Those who do evil and those who do nothing are equally worthy of contempt."
